rubrics.justification: It identifies a blastocyst and mentions ICM/TE/zona, but several image-based claims appear overstated or not clearly visible, such as intracytoplasmic debris within the blastocoel, partial TE discontinuity, and confident re-grading to 3BB-3AB from a single image.

It integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male factor context, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality reasonably well, though some links are somewhat generic and not tightly evidence-calibrated.

The structure is logical, but the probability adjustment scheme is somewhat ad hoc and double-counts uncertainty by penalizing both age-related aneuploidy and lack of PGT-A; some morphology concerns are also inferred more strongly than the image supports.

Many recommendations are broadly standard (SET, luteal support, lifestyle counseling), but routine PGT-A recommendation, ERA after a single failure, thrombophilia testing, and strong claims about alcohol exceed or are not consistently supported by major guideline-based practice.

It gives clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, follow-up timing, and additional male-factor workup, though some suggested tests/interventions may be more aggressive than necessary for this first cycle.
